roadmapLane: P1-A raw RPC account-frontier extraction for the DP adapter

implementation.gapClosed: Current DP raw views take accountFrontier as caller-authored four-field DATA. The only existing getFrontierAccountBlock call is in the locked SDK-backed payment path; no raw frame-to-frontier codec exists in the selected production modules.
implementation.contract: Expose the existing bounded result-envelope scanner through a new pure two-argument export without changing any existing core source byte. New pure decoder admits one version1 six-field UNSIGNED DATA input with independent expected chain identifier/payer/request ID and raw response JSON. Require the pinned node's exact25-field result shape, numeric version1 and positive chain/height lexemes with safe next height, canonical nonzero hash, expected payer/chain equality. Reuse existing payer address codec. Preserve numeric source lexemes using captured native JSON.parse context.source, fail closed if unavailable; do not trust rounded Number values. Null/unavailable frontier never becomes an empty account. Other result fields are syntactically bounded but not semantically authenticated or validated as a full account block.
implementation.input: Exactly6 enumerable DATA fields: frontierReadVersion:1, phase:UNSIGNED, expectedChainIdentifier, payerAddress, requestId and responseJson.
implementation.output: Only frozen {address, chainIdentifier, hash, height}, suitable as the existing raw view accountFrontier. No authentication or capability receipt.
implementation.wireBoundary: Only the pinned node's exact25-field version1 AccountBlock result shape. Only version/chain/address/hash/height are semantically projected/checked; other fields are bounded JSON, not full block/signature/hash/genesis/confirmation validation.
implementation.numericBoundary: Native JSON.parse may internally round Number values; the decoder never uses those rounded values for projected integers. It preserves the original primitive source in private numeric tokens, then accepts only canonical positive integer lexemes within the safe output domain and reserves height+1. Missing source context is a source-inspected fail-closed guard, not a separately simulated engine result.
implementation.emptyAccountBoundary: Null, missing, zero-height, zero-hash and reduced/unavailable result shapes reject; no empty-account fallback is introduced.
implementation.coreReuse: Add one synchronous snapshotBoundedJsonRpcReadResultText(text,expectedRequestId) export. Every earlier core byte remains an exact20906-byte prefix, SHA2565572d24175455c6b3a9924688d601d31585454ce62dac9eb27151d2a65c83fcd; this inverse check itself passed in the actual run. No existing transport/Promise/scanner code or allowlist was edited.
implementation.bounds: Decoder response<=65536 UTF8 bytes. Existing core duplicate/forbidden-key, Unicode, depth/value/member/string/result limits run before native parsing.
implementation.noEffects: No actual RPC, transport allowlist expansion, native owner, SDK, wallet, work producer, signature, payment, PREPARE, current-state/genesis/funding/authentication claim or active buyer/planner cutover. Real signer remains disabled.
